title: Cracked Oven Door
summary: The bakery oven door cracks on a Tuesday. The repair is one hundred eighty dollars.

title: Harbor Parking Fine
summary: The harbor posts a fine for leaving the cart in the loading lane.

title: School Trip Fund
summary: The class trip needs a share from the household. The ask is one hundred twenty dollars.

title: Burst Water Heater
summary: The water heater gives out before breakfast. A replacement is three hundred fifty dollars.

title: Phone Screen
summary: A dropped phone needs a new screen. The shop wants ninety dollars.

title: Unexpected Vet Visit
summary: The clinic fits in an unexpected visit. The bill is two hundred twenty dollars.

title: Train Fare Home
summary: The last ferry is cancelled. The train home costs sixty dollars.

title: Roof Leak Patch
summary: A leak over the kitchen needs a patch before the next rain. The roofer wants four hundred dollars.
